agreement.T: Normal points away from halfspace material: remove negative signed side.
agreement.F: Normal points into halfspace material: remove positive signed side.

ownedPlane: origin + outward-to-retained normal; subtractHalfSpace removes the positive signed side.
restriction: For admitted bounded A in exact domain D, A minus H = A minus (D intersect H); no arbitrary finite extent.
control: All admission, clipping, cap construction and Boolean reconstruction share original work/cancellation and output admission.
